name: Shadows Of Progakko
source:
Adam Samishi went to live at Progakko, a huge school with the purpose of protecting teenagers from a threat that occurs in the country, however, nobody knows what exactly this threat is.

[From [url=https://kuraishimi06.itch.io/shadows-of-progakko]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
亚当·萨米希来到Progakko居住。这是一所庞大的学校，宗旨是保护青少年免受国内某种威胁侵害。然而，没有人知道，那种威胁究竟是什么。

[摘自[url=https://kuraishimi06.itch.io/shadows-of-progakko]itch.io[/url]]
